entities.summary: Arab, a notable figure in the history of Turkmenistan, associated with Arab Conquest and Merv as Caliphal Center (651–750). Preceded by Abbasid Revolution from Merv. Their legacy influenced Merv under the Seljuks and Seljuk Turks.
